description: Manage PDF Studios in ONE tool (action=create|open|list|get, default create). Studios are never auto-listed in context — call action=list first to see EVERY studio with its state (id/title/pages/designed/orientation/open_url), or action=get with a studio_id for one studio's full details (slide states, orientation, assets). Create: call once with the studio title and the reason — ONLY when every listed studio already has designs. You may also pass pages: up to 10 short page descriptions taken from what the user said they want inside the PDF (one per slide) — the studio is created at once and every page design starts immediately in parallel in the background, so the user opens it and finds the designs already generating. Omit pages when the user did not specify the PDF content (empty studio, they drive it from inside). Open: call with the studio_id of a listed studio (prefer one with 0 designed) to hand it back instead of creating. Then end your reply with the Open Studio card ([STUDIO:pdf_N]) on its own line plus the studio link line (open_url) right after it, so gateway chats get the link as text. It only returns studio_id plus open_url — everything else happens later inside the studio itself.

action.description: list all studios, get one studio's details, create a new studio, or open an existing one (default create)

pages.description: Optional page descriptions for action=create (max 10, one per slide) — each starts its design in parallel at once

reason.description: Why this studio is created (one short line)

studio_id.description: Existing studio id for action=open|get, e.g. pdf_3

title.description: Unused studio name for action=create, e.g. Energy Report

name: pdf_studio
title: PDF Studio
